impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let Ok(record) = if self.use_the_first_consumer_for_this_block {
            &mut self.first_consumer_of_the_lane
        } else {
            &mut self.second_consumer_of_the_lane
        }
        .try_pop()
        {
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
